_comment: Measured defects used as NEGATIVE CONTROLS. House convention: a negative
control that stops reproducing is itself a finding, so a leg that expects a
defect and does not find it reports BROKEN telling you to delete the entry,
EVERY entry below was measured on the date it records. Nothing is predicted.
Groups with no measured entries are empty and say why.
The two L4 LANGUAGE defects this corpus found (NOT binding looser than AND;
a mixfix name ending in a keyword being undefinable-in-practice) are NOT
recorded here. They are defects in the toolchain, not in this subject's
projections, and they are reported upstream instead; etc/check-not-precedence.mjs
is the standing guard against the first.

wizard.why_empty: No wizard module exists for this subject yet, so `render --format plan` has no export surface to measure.

dmn.why_empty: The p7-dmn leg is not declared: no DMN golden, fidelity golden or cases file has been generated for this corpus, and recording unmeasured defects would be exactly the drift this orchestrator exists to prevent.

mcp.why_empty: No jl4-service was reachable when this file was written, and the corpus carries no @export surface to deploy.
